protocol.model: Delichatsios2000 Eq7 cylindrical solid energy balance, surface re-radiation and finite radial heated depth. Not a CFD solver, not a machine-learning predictor.
protocol.lengths: Vr=Ueffective+v; Lg_heat=alpha_heating/Vr; Lg_curv=alpha_curvature/Vr; Lsy=min(r,sqrt(alpha_s*Lg_heat/v)); alpha_s=ks/(rho_s*cp_s). Two effective diffusivities follow the source's distinction, not measured transport properties of our runs.
protocol.flow_extension: Thomsen2020 Eq6 at assumed P/P0=1: Ueffective=[Uf^4+(9.80665*g_fraction*kappa*r)^2]^(1/4). Combining this with the2000 energy equation is OUR conditional extension. No per-row pressure/temperature was recovered. kappa3.5 primary;1 and5.2 sensitivity; no partial-g validation.
protocol.energy_closure: E_FL=127*(Y_O2/0.233) W/m, Y_O2=32*x/(32*x+28*(1-x)), x=O2pct/100.127 is source CFD-derived air calibration at40cm/s, not a measured heat flux. Proportional scaling and use below air oxygen/at low flow are assumptions. No local labels enter constants.
protocol.numerics: Root search1e-10 to1m/s,1601log-spaced samples, Brent solve every sign-changing interval. Only unique roots returned; multiple/absent brackets abstain, not extinction labels. Tangential roots can be missed by bracketing; independent denser scan verifies encountered data. No output clipping or after-score parameter changes.
protocol.evaluation: All69 unchanged candidates; separateEarth35/19groups andISS34/11groups, strict-unitISS23/6groups reported separately. Equal-group MAE and RMSE. Report coverage and nulls before metrics; full-cohort score only at100% coverage. Compare fixed outputs to Round2 same-row heldout log_geometry_ridge predictions. No newly claimed holdout validation: labels and source-informed theory are previously seen.
protocol.omissions: No gas-phase radiative-loss closure, finite-rate chemistry, measured pressure sweep, high-O2 validation or regime-specific fitted thermal properties. No artificial minimum spread rate, no forced zero at unverified LOC, no fabricated uncertainty.
protocol.calibration: Zero local fitted parameters. No neural networks or fitted regressors. Inherited published simulation calibration is disclosed. This is not an ab-initio/no-calibration model. No local calibration in this step.
protocol.execution: CPU scalar root solving, not ML training. No GPU use claimed or needed.
protocol.gate: A useful full-cohort comparator must at least beat simple same-domain baseline; no safety tolerance established. No lunar/Mars accuracy claim regardless of endpoint score. Publish all scenarios, do not select a winner by observed labels. Freeze artifacts and stop for review.
